items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Well, right around the corner, let's see, Eddie South, Billy Taylor... They had a trio together.

ctx.x: When you were working at the Garrick and at the Two Deuces, who else was working around Chicago? What other music was being --
Well, right around the corner, let's see, Eddie South, Billy Taylor, and I can't remember who was on bass. It was really swinging in those days, you know?
Billy Taylor the bass player or Billy Taylor the piano player?
